battleship-ohio-forecastle.collection: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.
battleship-ohio-forecastle.credit_line: View from the forecastle deck of battleship Ohio, showing the Maine in the distance, Hampton Roads, Virginia, 1907. Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.
battleship-ohio-forecastle.note: Stereograph; one frame of the pair, delivered by LOC already cropped to the single frame, arched mask and all. Illustrative on the Yokohama question: the fleet's reception in Japan was searched for in the DAM and in the LOC Prints and Photographs catalogue (Yokohama, Tokyo, U.S. fleet Japan, battleships Japan 1908) and nothing pre-1919 exists. The white hull is, however, exactly the subject of the paint question.

fleet-at-magdalena-bay.description: Man of War Cove, Magdalena Bay, March 13, 1908
fleet-at-magdalena-bay.collection: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.
fleet-at-magdalena-bay.credit_line: Man of War Cove, Magdalena Bay, Mexico, 13 March 1908 — the fleet at anchor for target practice. Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.
fleet-at-magdalena-bay.note: Two-part panoramic gelatin silver print, 8 x 34 in., copyright deposit by H. R. Fitch, 24 March 1908. Cropped from the 2875x700 master: black mount border trimmed on all four sides, then cropped to the left half of the panorama, which carries the battleships and avoids the join between the two negatives. Photographed the day after the fleet anchored, and the ships on the water are the fleet itself.

fleet-review-sydney.rights: No known restrictions on publication. For more information, see George Grantham Bain Collection - Rights and Restrictions Information https://www.loc.gov/rr/print/res/274_bain.html
fleet-review-sydney.collection: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.
fleet-review-sydney.credit_line: U.S. Fleet at Sydney — Review, 1908. Photograph by the Bain News Service. Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.
fleet-review-sydney.note: Bain News Service glass negative, 1908, of the fleet's visit to Sydney during the world cruise. Cropped from the 5723x4109 master to remove the clear and black edges of the negative. The title lettered on the negative and the dark blot at the top left are the photographer's own and were left in.

coaling-st-thomas.description: Coaling U.S. battleships at St. Thomas, West Indies
coaling-st-thomas.collection: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.
coaling-st-thomas.credit_line: Coaling U.S. battleships at St. Thomas, West Indies, about 1906 — one frame of a stereograph card. Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.
coaling-st-thomas.note: United States Stereograph Co. card no. B 211, copyright 1906. Cropped from the 1536x786 master to the left frame, publisher mount and caption removed. Illustrative: St. Thomas in 1906, not a port of the world cruise, but the operation the coaling question is about — baskets of coal carried up a plank ramp by hand. Searches of the DAM and LOC for coaling during the cruise itself returned nothing.

suez-canal-mouth.collection: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.
suez-canal-mouth.credit_line: Mouth of the Suez Canal, Suez, Egypt, about 1900 — one frame of a stereograph card. Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.
suez-canal-mouth.note: Stereograph card copyrighted 1900 by Charles Thomas Woodbury Davis, no. 48, from the Marian S. Carson Collection. Cropped from the 5899x3004 master to the left frame, card mount removed. Illustrative: the canal about eight years before the fleet passed through it. No photograph of the fleet in the canal, at Port Said or at Suez could be found in the DAM or in the LOC catalogue.
